name: openbb_equity_screener
description:
Stock screener through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.screener).
Returns: {provider, results_count, truncated, results: [records with symbol, name, price, change, volume, market cap]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): sector (yfinance sectors, e.g. technology, healthcare); market_cap_min, market_cap_max (USD; yfinance's own minimum is 500 million when omitted); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 25; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, nasdaq, yfinance; default yfinance).
US-listed stocks with yfinance (its country filter returns nothing at present); by country: fmp_stock_screener. Ready-made lists: openbb_equity_discovery_gainers, _losers, _active. Keys: nasdaq, yfinance need none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"sector": "technology", "market_cap_min": 10000000000, "limit": 20}

market_cap_min.description: Minimum market cap in USD (sent as mktcap_min)

market_cap_max.description: Maximum market cap in USD (sent as mktcap_max)

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
